attack.description: Probed molecule_facts() with 5 chemically-valid SMILES encodings of dicyandiamide (all formula C2H4N4, all the same real molecule, differing only in which nitrogen a given kekulization/tautomer choice marks as the formal C=N): the fixture's canonical form ('NC(=NC#N)N'), the alternate tautomer with the double bond on a terminal amino nitrogen instead ('N=C(N)NC#N'), two reorderings of that alternate tautomer, and a PubChem-style atom ordering of the canonical tautomer.
attack.interpretation: 3 of 5 equally-valid encodings of the identical molecule scored 0 active hydrogens under fire 1's fix -- the categorical defect W-FFI1 refuted, reproduced via representation choice alone, on live production molecule_facts().

implementation.change: Was: loop over DOUBLE bonds only, take the double-bonded nitrogen, scan its other neighbors for a nitrile carbon. Now: loop over ALL neighboring atoms of the guanidine carbon (regardless of bond order), and for each nitrogen neighbor, scan ITS other neighbors for a nitrile carbon. is_amidine_or_guanidine_carbon (the outer C=N gate) is unchanged; only the narrower cyanamide-detection scan was broadened from 'the one formally-double-bonded N' to 'every directly-bonded N'.

objective: W-FFI2 (continued): the done_criterion requires the structural boundary to be genuinely structural, not an artifact of one particular SMILES encoding. This fire attacks fire 1's own repair with a representation-invariance probe (multiple chemically-valid tautomer/atom-ordering SMILES for dicyandiamide, same molecular formula C2H4N4) and, on finding it falsifies the fix, repairs the predicate to be bond-order-independent while re-verifying zero regressions against every prior probe set.

structural_criterion.statement: A guanidine/amidine carbon (has at least one C=N double bond to a nitrogen, per R-N02) is exempted from the categorical N-H exclusion IFF at least one nitrogen DIRECTLY BONDED TO IT -- regardless of whether that particular C-N bond is formally single or double in the parsed structure -- itself carries a nitrile (C#N) substituent. This is the dicyandiamide/cyanoguanidine motif (CAS 461-58-5): the cyanamide nitrile withdraws electron density from whichever resonance form is drawn, collapsing the guanidine's superbase pKaH from 13.6 to ~0.7 (chembk.com CAS 461-58-5 listing) regardless of tautomer. WO1993010168A1 (1993) states dicyandiamide has functionality four; Fedtke, Domaratius & Walter, Polymer Bulletin 31:429-435 (1993), DOI 10.1007/BF00329879, show its terminal amino nitrogens ring-open a glycidyl-ether epoxide model compound. Pure alkyl/aryl/H-substituted guanidines (DPG CAS 102-06-7, DOTG CAS 97-39-2, guanidine CAS 113-00-8, biguanide CAS 461-71-2) carry no nitrile on any directly-bonded nitrogen in any tautomer and remain fully excluded.
structural_criterion.why_bond_order_independent: Guanidine's three nitrogens are resonance-equivalent -- that is the entire premise of the Y-delocalization the R-N02 exclusion itself relies on. Restricting the cyanamide search to only the nitrogen RDKit's parser happened to mark as the formal double bond therefore encoded an input-representation artifact, not a chemical distinction. Scanning every directly-bonded nitrogen restores the structural (representation-invariant) character the fix was supposed to have.

supersedes.reason: Fire 1's cyanamide-substituted-guanidine-carbon predicate only inspected the DOUBLE-bonded (formal-imine) nitrogen of the guanidine/amidine carbon. Dicyandiamide's three guanidine nitrogens are resonance-equivalent by the same Y-delocalization argument the fix itself is premised on, so which nitrogen a given SMILES kekulizes as the formal C=N is a drawing convention, not a chemical fact. RDKit does not tautomer-canonicalize on parse. Feeding an equally valid alternate tautomer SMILES of the SAME molecule (e.g. 'N=C(N)NC#N' -- double bond on a terminal NH2 instead of the cyanamide nitrogen; formula C2H4N4 either way) scored 0 active hydrogens, not 4 -- silently reproducing the exact W-FFI1 defect on chemically-identical input. Every fixture that exercised the fire-1 fix (W-FFI1's ffi1-verify, V-N02c's vn02c-verify, the crate's own unit tests, amphora-molecule-role-ranker's known-answer file, amphora-molecule-capabilities' regression test) hardcodes the single string 'NC(=NC#N)N', so none could have caught this. Fire 1's receipt is NOT deleted or edited; this receipt supersedes it with a strictly broader predicate.

why: This fire's attack -- feeding molecule_facts() alternate but chemically-valid tautomer SMILES for dicyandiamide -- refuted fire 1's repair (3 of 5 representations of the identical molecule scored 0 instead of 4, reproducing the original W-FFI1 defect). The predicate was broadened to be bond-order/tautomer independent while preserving exact narrowness (n-methylguanidine and remote-nitrile adversarial probes still 0). Re-attacking the NEW predicate with the same tautomer probe now shows all 5 representations correctly score functionality 4, and re-running BOTH original unmodified refuting harnesses (W-FFI1's ffi1-verify, V-N02c's vn02c-verify) shows zero regressions beyond the already-intended dicyandiamide flip. A positive control (fire 1's narrower predicate, restored in a standalone mutant) confirms the new regression test has real power to catch the representation-dependence defect it targets. The CURRENT state of the claim -- as re-attacked by the strongest instrument available (tautomer-representation invariance) -- WITHSTANDS. Full workspace-green remains a separate, disclosed, outstanding item out of this fire's write scope.
